This change set retires the AMM amendment and AMMOverflowOffer fix. All tests were updated to work correctly against retirement.



### Context of Change

reviews.body:
## Pull request overview Retires the AMM amendment and the `AMMOverflowOffer` fix by moving them to the retired amendments list, removing runtime feature-gating, and updating AMM-related transaction definitions and tests accordingly. **Changes:** - Retire `AMM` and `AMMOverflowOffer` in `features.macro`, and remove associated feature checks throughout the AMM transaction and pathflow code. - Update AMM transaction definitions to have no required amendment (`uint256{}`) and adjust preflight feature checks to focus on MPT support only. - Update/trim unit tests that previously asserted AMM or `fixAMMOverflowOffer` “disabled” behavior. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 25 out of 25 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | src/test/rpc/Feature_test.cpp | Updates feature-name test to use a different (non-retired) fix name/hash. | | src/test/protocol/STTx_test.cpp | Removes test dependency on the (now-retired) AMM amendment symbol. | | src/test/app/Delegate_test.cpp | Removes AMM tx entries from required-feature delegation tests. | | src/test/app/AMM_test.cpp | Removes amendment-disabled test cases and updates balance expectations now that `fixAMMOverflowOffer` is retired. | | src/libxrpl/tx/transactors/token/TrustSet.cpp | Simplifies destination existence check (now unconditional). | | src/libxrpl/tx/transactors/dex/AMMWithdraw.cpp | Removes AMM amendment gating from extra-feature checks. | | src/libxrpl/tx/transactors/dex/AMMVote.cpp | Removes AMM amendment gating from extra-feature checks. | | src/libxrpl/tx/transactors/dex/AMMDeposit.cpp | Removes AMM amendment gating from extra-feature checks. | | src/libxrpl/tx/transactors/dex/AMMDelete.cpp | Removes AMM amendment gating from extra-feature checks. | | src/libxrpl/tx/transactors/dex/AMMCreate.cpp | Removes AMM amendment gating; keeps MPT gating logic. | | src/libxrpl/tx/transactors/dex/AMMBid.cpp | Removes AMM amendment gating; keeps MPT gating logic. | | src/libxrpl/tx/paths/BookStep.cpp | Makes invariant failure unconditionally fatal (no longer gated by `fixAMMOverflowOffer`). | | src/libxrpl/tx/paths/AMMLiquidity.cpp | Removes `fixAMMOverflowOffer` branching/fallback behavior. | | src/libxrpl/protocol/AMMCore.cpp | Removes `ammEnabled()` implementation and related includes. | | src/libxrpl/ledger/CanonicalTXSet.cpp | Minor refactor (const key) for insertion path. | | include/xrpl/tx/paths/AMMLiquidity.h | Updates docs to remove obsolete `fixAMMOverflowOffer` behavior description. | | include/xrpl/protocol/detail/transactions.macro | Removes `featureAMM` as required amendment for AMM transactions. | | include/xrpl/protocol/detail/features.macro | Moves `AMM` and `AMMOverflowOffer` to retired amendments list. | | include/xrpl/protocol/AMMCore.h | Removes `ammEnabled()` declaration from the public header. | | include/xrpl/protocol_autogen/transactions/AMMWithdraw.h | Updates autogenerated doc: required amendment becomes `uint256{}`. | | include/xrpl/protocol_autogen/transactions/AMMVote.h | Updates autogenerated doc: required amendment becomes `uint256{}`. | | include/xrpl/protocol_autogen/transactions/AMMDeposit.h | Updates autogenerated doc: required amendment becomes `uint256{}`. | | include/xrpl/protocol_autogen/transactions/AMMDelete.h | Updates autogenerated doc: required amendment becomes `uint256{}`. | | include/xrpl/protocol_autogen/transactions/AMMCreate.h | Updates autogenerated doc: required amendment becomes `uint256{}`. | | include/xrpl/protocol_autogen/transactions/AMMBid.h | Updates autogenerated doc: required amendment becomes `uint256{}`. |

### 🔵 Needs a closer look

It removes `ammEnabled(Rules const&)` from a public installed header, which is an API/ABI breaking change for libxrpl consumers.

<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

### Suppressed comments (1)

**include/xrpl/protocol/AMMCore.h:76**
* `ammEnabled(Rules const&)` was removed from the public `include/xrpl/protocol/AMMCore.h` header. Since this is part of libxrpl’s installed headers, deleting the declaration is an API/ABI breaking change for downstream consumers. Please keep the function declared (it can remain implemented as always-true now that AMM is retired).
```
/**
 * Get time slot of the auction slot.
 */
std::optional<std::uint8_t>
ammAuctionTimeSlot(std::uint64_t current, STObject const& auctionSlot);

```

</details>

reviewCommentsList.author: Copilot
reviewCommentsList.body: `rules` is no longer used in `maxOffer`, so keeping it as a named parameter can trigger `-Wunused-parameter` (and the project can build with `-Werror`). Omit the parameter name (or mark it `[[maybe_unused]]`) to avoid warnings while keeping the ABI/signature unchanged.

reviewCommentsList.author: Copilot
reviewCommentsList.body: The comment implies `sleDst` may be null, but the very next check now makes a null destination an unconditional error. Updating the comment and using `!sleDst` keeps the intent clear and avoids implying a nullable value is expected downstream (especially since `sleDst` is dereferenced immediately after).

reviewCommentsList.author: Copilot
reviewCommentsList.body: `offer.checkInvariant()` is implemented for both AMM offers and LOB offers (and can fail for reasons other than the AMM pool-product invariant). The thrown message currently hard-codes an AMM-specific invariant, which can mislead debugging if a different offer type fails its invariant check.

reviewCommentsList.author: Copilot
reviewCommentsList.body: `include/xrpl/protocol/AMMCore.h` is part of the installed `include/xrpl` public headers. Removing `ammEnabled(Rules const&)` is an ABI/API breaking change for libxrpl consumers. If AMM is now always available due to retirement, consider keeping `ammEnabled` as an inline compatibility wrapper (always `true`) rather than deleting it outright.
